# P32.13 — release generation/storage measurement (SIG-FIND-001/002, ADR-132)

Measured by `sig-exports release measure` (`exports.release.measure_build`) over
the checked-in national export `exports/out/national` — the full ~230k-record
corpus, not a fixture. Offline; nothing deployed.

kept separate exactly as in the export bundle (ADR-011/§42.3).

## Consequence

- ~475k static files is the real shape of the full-corpus release: the serving
  layer must treat `r/<pub>/` as an immutable bulk tree (hardlink staging,
  whole-artifact deny, `location =` tombstone map), not a page set — recorded
  as an ADR-132 revisit trigger if file counts ever exceed hosting limits.
- Record routes exist for all 236,994 records — orders of magnitude beyond the
  old first-500 slice; routes are enumerated from the compartment projection,
  never paginated from a capped index.
